searchText: hmm my understanding of the pattern is that it creates the contract and then immediately self-destructs it, no? Or is this the other pattern where the contract itself talks to a separate contract for its storage, so you can upgrade its code by selfdestructing and replacing it? If so, then sure, that pattern is cheaper for calls, though it's more expensive for storage reads
